title: Circle Membership Liaison Note: What a Membership or a Plan Changes on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Return
content:
Holding a Circle membership changes the return schedule the line falls under and what the return costs: where the schedule takes the member extension, the membership tier's window extension days are added to the schedule's window, and *the tier's restocking fee waiver percentage is applied to the fee the schedule charges* — that clause is **no longer in force**, superseded for Northbeam Returns and Restocking by the current basis on which the membership's relief against a restocking fee is worked out. The extension is read from the membership tier standing on the day the return is asked for, not the tier held when the item was bought, and a membership in grace on a tier that suspends benefits gives no extension at all. Holding a protection plan on the returned item does not extend the window, and the plan is cancelled with the return where the schedule says so, its premium refunded under the plan's own free-look or pro rata rules rather than as part of the refund worked out here. A member who returns an item bought with reward points has the points restored rather than refunded in money, and the money part of a split payment is refunded by the method the schedule requires. Where both the membership waiver and a defective grade would waive the same fee the fee is waived once, and the defective grade is recorded as the reason because it is the stronger ground.

## Which tier is read, and when

| Question | The answer this note gives |
| --- | --- |
| Which membership tier supplies the window extension? | the tier standing on the day the return is asked for |
| Does the tier held when the item was bought matter? | no |
| What does a membership in grace on a tier that suspends benefits give? | no extension at all |
| Which schedules take the extension at all? | those whose terms say the member extension applies |

## What a protection plan on the item does and does not do

It does not extend the return window. Where the schedule says so, the plan is cancelled with the return, and its premium comes back under the plan's own free-look or pro rata rules rather than as part of the refund worked out at this desk.

## Reward points and split payments

An item bought with reward points has the points restored rather than refunded in money. Where the payment was split, the money part is refunded by the method the schedule requires.

## Where two grounds would relieve the same fee

Where both the membership waiver and a defective grade would waive the same fee, the fee is waived once, and the defective grade is recorded as the reason, because it is the stronger ground.

superseded_clauses: the tier's restocking fee waiver percentage is applied to the fee the schedule charges
